notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 'to black' was a no-op on a black tyre -> bright yellow, ref names the near wheel of the black-canopied becak. U2 canopy is the rightmost becak's (ref said left) and the replace payload was a bare colour -> structural replace with a striped umbrella. U3 was an arbitrary vine fragment in the top-right corner (ref said left) -> retargeted to the blue motorbike partly visible at the right edge (SAM3 v2; parts behind the becak frame excluded). The 'green bicycle' between becaks was rejected as a retarget: it is the driver section of the left becak.
